en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large historicist-style corner building with elaborate façades, columns, and a central tower-like roof feature. People in late 19th–early 20th century clothing walk along the cobblestone street, and a horse-drawn carriage stands in front of the building. Printed German captions identify the building as the imperial and royal post and telegraph office and send greetings from Graz. A circular archival stamp and the printed year 1903 appear at the bottom.
